# Deep Research Intelligence Packet

## Cycle metadata

- Packet ID: `dr-20260922-1005-candidate-validation`
- Research system: `Codex web research`
- Started at: `2026-09-22 10:05 CDT`
- Completed at: `2026-09-22 10:08 CDT`
- Research scope: Four unresolved rank-1 McDonald's candidate pages, plus bounded corroboration of a named franchise operator and the vendor's current McDonald's landing page
- Queue item or vendor: `company:brand-mcdonald-s`; Restaurant365
- Methodology: Candidate-page validation and narrow corroboration; vendor claims are retained as vendor-reported evidence rather than canonical facts

## Executive result

- Pages reviewed: 6 (four candidate pages, one current Restaurant365 McDonald's landing page, and one Ice Age Management leadership page that timed out)
- Candidate pages validated: 4
- Brand-vendor-product observations added or revised: 3
- Conflicts found: 1
- Material takeaway: Restaurant365 now claims 3,500+ McDonald's franchise locations run their books on R365 and provides a named Ice Age Management testimonial covering 54 locations. This materially strengthens the relationship beyond the earlier generic owner-operator indication, but the count and product claims remain vendor-reported and franchisee-scoped, not proof of a McDonald's corporate or systemwide deployment.

## Evidence observations

### Observation 1

- Brand: McDonald's
- Vendor: Restaurant365
- Product or category: R365 Accounting / restaurant ERP; QSR Soft POS-to-GL connection; AP automation; Voosh third-party-delivery reconciliation; real-time reporting
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: franchisee
- Evidence type: other (vendor brand landing page)
- Confidence: 80%
- Confidence rationale: The vendor makes a specific current installed-base claim on a dedicated McDonald's page and names product integrations, but no independent source or auditable customer list validates the aggregate.
- Source title: McDonald's | Restaurant365
- Source URL: https://www.restaurant365.com/mcdonalds/
- Publisher or source owner: Restaurant365
- Published date, if known: Not shown
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: The page says 3,500+ McDonald's franchise locations are already using Restaurant365 for their books.
- Product-specific evidence: R365 Accounting, QSR Soft sales-data integration, AP automation for named McDonald's vendors, Voosh delivery reconciliation, and traceable real-time reporting.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Vendor-reported aggregate; franchise locations only. It does not establish adoption by McDonald's corporate, all franchisees, or every McDonald's location.
- Recommended follow-up: Seek a McDonald's owner-operator association reference, integration documentation, or additional named franchise-group evidence to validate the aggregate.

### Observation 2

- Brand: McDonald's
- Vendor: Restaurant365
- Product or category: Restaurant ERP, accounting automation, QSRsoft/Martin Brower/RTI integrations, reporting, budgeting, bank reconciliation, and AP workflow
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: franchisee
- Evidence type: testimonial
- Confidence: 90%
- Confidence rationale: Restaurant365 publishes a named CFO testimonial with a 54-location scope, and Ice Age Management's official site identifies the same executive and the company as a McDonald's franchise management group. The official Ice Age page timed out during this run, so the independent corroboration was available only through its indexed result.
- Source title: Big Mac, Bigger Margins: How McDonald's Keeps Profits Supersized with R365
- Source URL: https://www.restaurant365.com/blog/big-mac-bigger-margins-how-mcdonalds-keeps-profits-supersized-with-restaurant365/
- Publisher or source owner: Restaurant365
- Published date, if known: Not shown
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: Ice Age Management CFO Joshua Lacer-Wadkins says the company transitioned to R365 and describes the ERP as seamless across 54 locations and multiple entities.
- Product-specific evidence: ERP, QSRsoft, Martin Brower and RTI integrations, automated AP approval, reporting across sales/labor/food costs, budgeting, financial planning, bank reconciliation, and PAC analysis.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Restaurant365 and the current landing page say 54 locations; other indexed 2025 material describes Ice Age as operating more than 50 locations, while an older Ice Age handbook described 16 locations in 2016. The figures appear time-dependent rather than necessarily contradictory.
- Recommended follow-up: Capture a current Ice Age locations page or direct case study to independently confirm the 54-location count and present deployment status.

### Observation 3

- Brand: McDonald's owner-operators served by Laufer LLP
- Vendor: Restaurant365
- Product or category: Accounting, operations, payroll, reporting, labor accruals, AP, bank reconciliation, budgeting, and franchise-specific workflows
- Relationship indication: partner
- Deployment scope: franchisee
- Evidence type: other (recorded webinar and vendor interview)
- Confidence: 75%
- Confidence rationale: Two Restaurant365 pages explicitly describe Laufer LLP's Restaurant365 partnership and McDonald's owner-operator use, but they are same-publisher sources and do not identify every adopting operator.
- Source title: The Back-Office Advantage for McDonald's Owner Operators
- Source URL: https://www.restaurant365.com/webinars/recorded-webinars/the-back-office-advantage-for-mcdonalds-owner-operators/
- Publisher or source owner: Restaurant365
- Published date, if known: August 20; year not displayed
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: The webinar page says McDonald's owner-operators shared how they address financial challenges through Restaurant365 and Laufer LLP, and calls R365 Laufer's exclusive technology partner.
- Product-specific evidence: Labor accrual, AP and bank-reconciliation automation; real-time financial visibility; budgeting; customized reporting; connected accounting, operations and payroll.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Laufer serves operators associated with more than 900 McDonald's restaurants, but the page does not say all those restaurants use R365. The separate interview describes a 31-restaurant McDonald's client and broader client use without tying that named growth story unambiguously to R365.
- Recommended follow-up: Identify named Laufer client groups and distinguish Laufer's service footprint from the subset deployed on R365.

## Negative findings

- Candidate or claim: All four pages independently prove distinct McDonald's deployments.
- Pages checked: The four candidate URLs below.
- Result: They substantially overlap as Restaurant365 marketing content. Two pages provide useful relationship evidence, while the real-time-reporting article is product marketing without a named operator and the webinar/interview pages largely reinforce the same Laufer owner-operator channel. They should not be counted as four independent deployments.

- Candidate or claim: The 3,500+ location statement proves enterprise or systemwide adoption.
- Pages checked: Restaurant365's McDonald's landing page.
- Result: The claim is explicitly franchise-location scoped and vendor-reported. It does not establish McDonald's corporate adoption or complete franchise coverage.

## Source ledger

| URL | Source type | Accessed | Supports observation(s) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| https://www.restaurant365.com/webinars/recorded-webinars/the-back-office-advantage-for-mcdonalds-owner-operators/ | recorded webinar | 2026-09-22 | Observation 3 | Explicit Laufer-R365 partnership and McDonald's owner-operator workflow claims |
| https://www.restaurant365.com/blog/some-mcdonalds-franchisees-are-doing-this-to-scale-and-automate-accounting/ | vendor interview/blog | 2026-09-22 | Observation 3 | Supports Laufer channel and client use; unnamed 31-location story is not treated as a separately verified deployment |
| https://www.restaurant365.com/blog/stop-playing-ketchup-how-mcdonalds-stays-ahead-with-real-time-financial-reporting/ | vendor blog | 2026-09-22 | Observation 1 (supporting only) | Product-specific McDonald's franchisee marketing; no named operator or distinct deployment |
| https://www.restaurant365.com/blog/big-mac-bigger-margins-how-mcdonalds-keeps-profits-supersized-with-restaurant365/ | vendor blog/testimonial | 2026-09-22 | Observation 2 | Named Ice Age Management CFO and 54-location testimonial |
| https://www.restaurant365.com/mcdonalds/ | vendor brand landing page | 2026-09-22 | Observations 1 and 2 | Specific 3,500+ franchise-location claim and Ice Age testimonial |
| https://iceagemcd.com/leadership-team/ | operator site | 2026-09-22 | Observation 2 (limited corroboration) | Page timed out when opened; indexed official-site result identifies Joshua Lacer-Wadkins and Ice Age as a McDonald's franchise management group |

## Research notes and inferences

- Inference: Restaurant365 has meaningful penetration among McDonald's franchisees. This follows from the dedicated vendor page, the 3,500+ vendor-reported count, named Ice Age testimonial, and Laufer channel evidence; it is not a McDonald's-corporate confirmation.
- Inference: The four candidate pages are best treated as overlapping support for one franchisee-market relationship rather than independent customer wins.
- No evidence from this batch was written directly into canonical account or ecosystem records. The morning intelligence cycle should triage this packet under RB's review-first rules.
